# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Fill in the **Appliance Details** section, including any attachments/ photos.
3. Do **not** check "Pass (not visually inspectable)"
4. Cross the other Pass checkbox and write "Failed" beneath it.
5. Mark any faults in the "Failures" section in red and provide a clear explanation why this appliance is a fail.
6. Leave the details on the right blank.
7. Move the test record out of the way and get on with the next test record.
8. If you are unsure of anything relating to a failure, take a photo of the whole appliance and a closeup of the fault, print out the test record at a good resolution, and fill in all the red failure details.
